name: qkd_static_kv_landing_row_h2-h2-d602e2d58
purpose: KVCTRL 1815 (lead Q-KV 2026-10-16): structural variant of qkd_static_kv_landing_seg. The flat ls5 tile (151.2 x 1,512 um) is 9 % utilised and its ONE ck root measured 722..753 ps TT insertion over 1,512 um (9,492 sinks): even a CLOSED flat view fails native launch (<= 220 ps). qkd_static_kv_landing_seg_h = wires-only parent of hardened children with short local roots: 4 x qkd_static_kv_landing_lane (one master: landing PC + SRAM + that PC's 256-b response data pipe, at the PC pitch; lanes 2/3 mirrored), qkd_static_kv_landing_row (rowctl DATA 0 + near-branch hops 1/2) at the centre, 2 x qkd_static_kv_landing_relay (far-branch 0/3 hops, half way). Same registers, same edges: cycle-identical to the flat seg (latency 8); cycles_added 0. Bench = the flat seg bench with seg_h as DUT (run_landing_seg_h.sh) + the flat bench logs compared. Row at the strip centre: W = head request/response control, E = arm/epoch/layer, S = lanes 0 (via relay) / 1, N = lanes 2 / 3 (via relay). h2 RTL (588ae143d, lead Q-KV 2026-10-17 reach rule <= 446 um for shared pins): arm/epoch/layer/cfg_stack/cfg_group are registered upstream in the row (lanes 1/2) and the relays (lanes 0/3) as the PC's own input registers (landing_pc PRE_REG 1); lane rst_n = a registered copy (+1 edge reset guard only). Bench: all 10 runs IDENTICAL to the flat seg, mutant FAIL.
